prerequisites.note: Treat A3 evidence as reviewed-on-branch until #160 merges; do not treat proposal as frozen until Sol authorizes.

authority_boundary.r1t_output_feeds: existing R1 median-centering path only when already_at_10Hz regular grid

recommended_timestamp_rule.grid_origin: t0 = first valid sample timestamp after validation; t[k]=t0 + k/10
pipeline: validate timestamps: finite, strictly increasing after duplicate policy
duplicate timestamps: KEEP_FIRST then require strict increase
compute median_dt; require source_median_hz = 1/median_dt >= 12.0 (Nyquist headroom vs 5 Hz)
fail if any consecutive gap > max(0.25 s, 2.5*median_dt)
linear interpolate onto fixed intermediate regular grid at 20.0 Hz over [t0, t_last]
zero-phase Butterworth order=4, cutoff_hz=4.0 (filtfilt) on intermediate series
emit NativeTraceInput sampling_rate_hz=10.0 with exact grid for frozen R1 median centering

parameter_justification_without_c1_label: ROLE_L/R2 respiratory band upper bound 0.7 Hz << 4 Hz
target 10 Hz Nyquist = 5 Hz; cutoff 4 Hz provides fixed anti-alias margin
intermediate 20 Hz is fixed integer multiple of 10 and >= documented C1 ~19 fps

recommended_timestamp_rule.interpolation_method: numpy.interp linear between bracketing measured samples
recommended_timestamp_rule.edge_behavior: no extrapolation beyond [t0,t_last]; output length = floor((t_last-t0)*10)+1 truncated to samples fully covered

range_roi_justification: SciData documents excluding first 28 range columns to remove near-field reflections and direct-path artifacts
28 * 0.0512 m ≈ 1.4336 m aligns with published d_offset=1.44 m near-field accounting
Same cut applies to Presence and Absence (authors state absence follows same setup)
Does NOT use PRESENT/ABSENT labels or model scores
recommended_range_rule.static_suppression: subtract per-bin complex temporal mean over the full recording (or full window source series)
recommended_range_rule.bin_reducer_rule: argmax of mean(|dyn|^2) over time within ROI; tie-break lowest bin index
recommended_range_rule.centering: deferred to frozen R1 full-recording median subtract after R1T yields 10 Hz

window_rule.after_r1_median_center: fixed first 300 samples at 10 Hz (30.0 s); no re-center after slice

forbidden_fitting: fit cutoff/ROI/bin rule on C1 labels
limitations: Through-wall electrical range ≠ free-space meters; ROI is near-field exclusion not calibrated permittivity mapping
Robot angular positions change path length; single-bin argmax may move across -5..+5 without being class-driven
Cross-sensor domain risk vs MR60/D0 remains HIGH
TRAIN z-score amplitude semantics may mismatch UWB phase scale
